# GovFacts

> > GovFacts is a comprehensive guide to understanding U.S. government operations, policies, and their impact on citizens' rights and daily lives.

GovFacts, operated by Something Better, Inc., provides accessible explanations of government structure, policy areas, and civic concepts. The site covers foundational government knowledge alongside in-depth policy analysis across major domains including healthcare, education, criminal justice, elections, and emerging challenges.

## Key Topics

- U.S. Government Structure
- Constitutional Rights
- Policy Analysis
- Healthcare Policy
- Education Policy
- Criminal Justice
- Elections and Voting
- Government Accountability
- Climate and Energy
- Foreign Policy
- AI Governance
- Housing Policy
- Congressional Oversight
- Economic Policy

## Foundational Government Knowledge

- [GovFacts Homepage](https://govfacts.org): GovFacts homepage: understand government operations and policies
- [How Government Works](https://govfacts.org/government): Guide to U.S. government structure and separation of powers
- [Your Rights and Freedoms](https://govfacts.org/rights-freedoms): Guide to Bill of Rights, constitutional rights, and freedoms

## Policy Coverage by Topic

- [Health and Healthcare](https://govfacts.org/health-healthcare): Articles on Medicare, Medicaid, ACA, and healthcare policy
- [Education, Family and Social Services](https://govfacts.org/education-family-social-services): Articles on education policy, Title IX, and social services
- [Criminal Justice and Public Safety](https://govfacts.org/criminal-justice-public-safety): Articles on criminal justice system and law enforcement
- [Elections and Voting](https://govfacts.org/elections-voting): Articles on voting rights, elections, and electoral systems
- [Economy and Your Money](https://govfacts.org/money): Articles on economy, finance, trade, and personal money topics
- [Housing and Infrastructure](https://govfacts.org/housing-infrastructure): Articles on housing policy, LIHTC, and infrastructure
- [Climate, Energy and Environment](https://govfacts.org/climate-energy-environment): Articles on climate policy, energy, and environmental regulation
- [Technology and Innovation](https://govfacts.org/tech-innovation): Articles on AI governance, tech policy, and digital rights
- [Foreign Policy and National Security](https://govfacts.org/policy-security): Articles on foreign policy, national security, and war powers

## Government Oversight and Accountability

- [Government Accountability and Ethics](https://govfacts.org/accountability-ethics): Articles on government accountability, ethics, and oversight
- [Long-term Challenges and the Future](https://govfacts.org/long-term-challenges-future): Articles on fiscal crisis, AI regulation, and future policy
